Gennaro has $276480 in his Pension Fund. Option A: Receive 25% of the $276480 now plus 5.5% of the remaining 75% each year. Option B: Receive 5.5% of the whole $276480 each year. Show that the total amount Gennaro will have received at the end of 10 years, if he chooses option A, is $183168.
After how many whole years will the total amount received using option B become more than the total amount received under option A?
The $276480 is 8% more than the amount the Pension Fund was worth one year ago. Calculate how much it was worth one year ago.

Justine travels 760 km in her car. Justine's average speed for the journey is 77 km/h. Calculate the time Justine takes to complete the journey. Give your answer in hours and minutes correct to the nearest minute.
